sources: UCI Machine Learning Repository: N-BaIoT Dataset (Y. Meidan et al.)
description: Standardized flow-level network telemetry from benign commercial IoT devices and botnet malware captures (Mirai, BASHLITE/Gafgyt, Torii).

0.label: Normal
0.description: Routine IoT telemetry (NTP, DNS, MQTT, RTSP video streams)

1.label: Suspicious
1.description: Reconnaissance port sweeps, anomalous cadence, slow C2 beacons

2.label: High-Risk
2.description: Active botnet incursion: Mirai brute-force, SYN flood, reflection

limitations: Flow statistics do not capture zero-day evasion in encrypted TLS payloads beyond entropy.
Device categories (e.g., smart cameras streaming video vs smart plugs) exhibit wide baseline variance.
Synthetic sampling models the statistical distributions of the CTU IoT-23 capture logs.
